title: Information Technology Manager
description:
Overview

We are looking for an experienced engineer to join the Cybersecurity/IT Engineering team as a full time Manager of IT. The ideal candidate is comfortable wearing many different hats including supporting end users, managing endpoints, automating identity and access management, and administering cloud-based IT systems and tools. A successful candidate will have demonstrated previous success in similar role(s) in rapidly growing, security-first environments. The right person is passionate about automation, scripting, and building infrastructure as code. You will be a participant in the design, implementation and management of our growing corporate cloud first infrastructure and networks. You will have a passion for innovation and creative problem solving, as well as be adaptable to the ever-changing landscape of the corporate infrastructure environment. This role will report to the Director of IT.

Responsibilities

  • Provide customer-facing IT support; act as the first line of support via channels like Slack and Jira.
  • Own the onboarding experience and tech provisioning for new employees; manage equipment procurement and tech retrieval for departing employees.
  • Design, test, build, document programs and policies; contribute improvements to existing knowledge bases.
  • Support and manage SaaS applications (Google Workspace, Slack, Jamf Pro, Jamf Protect, Jamf Connect, Okta, Jira, etc.).
  • Manage Mac endpoints and mobile device management tools (MDM/EMM, Jamf, etc.).
  • Improve identity and access management (IDP/SSO) with tools like GSuite and Okta; integrate APIs to connect systems.
  • Provide remote support across multiple countries/time zones; handle shipping and customs for hardware.
  • Communicate clearly, write effective tickets and documentation, and create helpful articles; automate repetitive tasks where possible.
  • Lead and participate in projects over sprints with Agile methods; track work in Jira and align objectives with team and company goals.
  • Manage critical incidents and issues to resolution; prioritise and balance workload across teams.

What You Bring to Ledn

  • 7+ years in SaaS systems administration (Jamf Pro, Google Workspace, Okta, Slack, Jira, Netsuite).
  • Ability to create automations using bash, zsh, Python, etc.; experience with open source tooling (Nudge, CIS Benchmark scripts, SplashBuddy, Munki, etc.).
  • Experience integrating SSO (Okta) and building workflows; working with APIs to connect systems.
  • Experience providing remote support across time zones; familiarity with hardware shipping/receiving and customs.
  • Excellent written and verbal communication; ability to explain complex concepts clearly and empathetically.
  • Strong understanding of networking fundamentals (TCP/IP, DNS, DHCP, VLANs, routing/switching) and OSI model troubleshooting; methodical problem solving.
  • Self-management with ability to scope projects, prioritize tasks, and collaborate across multiple teams.
  • Culture fit: leadership mindset, adaptability, resilience, and comfort in a remote/high-growth environment.

Nice to Haves

  • Some familiarity with AWS; GAM and command-line tooling experience.
  • Jamf certifications, Okta certifications, Google Workspace certifications.

What Ledn Offers

  • Competitive total rewards package and opportunities for growth.
  • Competitive PTO; company ownership through equity.
  • Remote work flexibility up to 180 days globally (subject to restrictions).
  • A mission-driven environment with a focus on diversity, inclusion, and equal opportunity employment.

Equal Opportunity

Ledn is an equal opportunity employer and prides itself on inclusivity and diversity. For accommodation requests during recruitment, please email the Ledn team. Requests will be handled confidentially.

Working Environment

Ledn is a global, remote-first company with employees across North America, Latin America, South Africa and Europe. Due to high application volume, qualified applicants will be contacted. Shortlisted candidates may be asked to submit a short video response and we may review publicly available social media activity relevant to the role. No agencies or recruiters. We do not accept unsolicited agency resumes.

title: Senior Product Designer
description:
Overview

About CharterUP. CharterUP is transforming the $30 billion group transportation industry with cutting-edge technology and innovative SaaS software, delivering an industry-leading experience for both customers and operators. Trusted by most Fortune 500 companies, our platform connects users to thousands of charter bus and minibus operators nationwide. In just 60 seconds, customers can access real-time availability, transparent pricing, and detailed vehicle options—whether organizing a corporate event, a company shuttle, or a wedding. By streamlining what was once a fragmented and stressful process, CharterUP brings transparency, accountability, and efficiency to an industry overdue for innovation. With CharterUP, group transportation is no longer a hassle but an elevated, reliable experience. Join us as we lead the future of group travel.

Why Join Us

  • Innovative Impact: Be part of the team that's revolutionizing group travel, setting new standards in an industry overdue for change.
  • Growth Opportunities: As a hyper growth company and one of the fastest-growing companies recognized by Inc., there’s no better time to join our dynamic, growth-stage organization.
  • Driven Team: Collaborate with some of the most driven minds in tech, all while working in a remote-first environment with a tech hub in Austin, TX.
  • Funding and Stability: Our $60 million Series A funding was just the start—we’re poised for even greater expansion, and you can be part of this exciting journey. CharterUP has achieved growth, profitability, and stability.

About the Role

Senior Product Designer to lead the design of a new, high-impact product within our growing mobility platform. This role blends UX strategy, visual design, and product thinking—from user research and usability testing to building intuitive, production-ready interfaces in Figma. You’ll collaborate closely with product managers, engineers, and designers, helping shape a cohesive design system and elevating the overall product experience. This position offers the opportunity to work in a startup-paced environment, where your ideas will directly influence product direction and user satisfaction.

Title: Senior Product Designer

Reports to: Chief Product Officer

What You’ll Do

  • Design from Discovery to Delivery: Conduct user research and usability testing, translate insights into wireframes and prototypes, and ship elegant, production-ready designs.
  • Own the Visual System: Create scalable, consistent design components in Figma, contributing to and expanding our design system.
  • Collaborate Cross-Functionally: Partner with product managers, engineers, and other designers to define problems, explore solutions, and iterate quickly.
  • Champion the User: Bring a user-first mindset to ensure designs are functional, accessible, and visually cohesive across platforms.
  • Contribute to Culture: Collaborate with the broader design team (4+ designers plus UX lead) to evolve design standards, processes, and best practices.

What You’ll Bring

  • Experience: 5+ years of hands-on product design experience spanning UI and UX for web or mobile applications.
  • Figma Expertise: Deep proficiency in Figma, including component libraries, prototyping, and collaborative workflows.
  • Product Mindset: Proven success designing within software development environments, collaborating closely with engineers and PMs.
  • User-Centric Skills: Strong background in usability testing, user interviews, and turning insights into thoughtful design solutions.
  • Portfolio Quality: Work that demonstrates polished, interaction-focused design for complex digital products.
  • Communication: Excellent English skills (written and spoken).
  • Work Ethic: Startup mentality — proactive, adaptable, and able to thrive in a fast-paced environment.
  • Nice-to-Have: Experience designing for B2B, logistics, or other complex system-driven products.

Global Benefits & Perks at CharterUP

  • Remote-First Flexibility: Work from anywhere we hire, with built-in flexibility. U.S.-based employees may reside in any of our 19 approved states.
  • Comprehensive Health & Wellness: Medical, dental, and vision insurance, mental health support, virtual care, gym discounts, and family-building benefits. In the U.S., we cover 100% of premiums for employees. International benefits align with local standards.
  • Time Off to Recharge: Paid time off so you can truly unplug. U.S.: 15 PTO days (increasing to 20 after 2 years) + 8 paid holidays. International policies vary by country.
  • Financial Peace of Mind: Company-paid life, short-term, and long-term disability insurance where available.
  • Performance-Driven Culture: Join a fast-moving, ambitious, and collaborative team that wins together.
  • Referral Rewards: Earn bonuses for bringing top talent to the team.
  • Planning for the Future: Long-term financial planning support. U.S.: 401(k) plan. International: region-specific savings programs where applicable.
  • Top-Tier Tech: Choose a Mac or PC, plus monitor, keyboard, and mouse to hit the ground running.

CharterUP is an Equal Opportunity Employer. We are committed to creating an inclusive, accessible, and respectful workplace. We consider all qualified applicants without regard to race, color, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity or expression, age, national origin, ancestry, disability, medical condition, marital status, veteran status, or any other protected characteristic in accordance with applicable federal, state, and local laws in the United States and Canada. If you require accommodation during the recruitment process, please let us know. CharterUP is committed to providing reasonable accommodations during the hiring process. If you need assistance or an accommodation, please contact your recruiter.

title: Senior Financial/Accounting Specialist - Simpaul Brazil (EN Speaker)
description:
Overview

Binance is a leading global blockchain ecosystem behind the world’s largest cryptocurrency exchange by trading volume and registered users. We are trusted by over 280 million people in 100+ countries for our industry-leading security, user fund transparency, trading engine speed, deep liquidity, and an unmatched portfolio of digital-asset products. Binance offerings range from trading and finance to education, research, payments, institutional services, Web3 features, and more. We leverage the power of digital assets and blockchain to build an inclusive financial ecosystem to advance the freedom of money and improve financial access for people around the world.

Company Overview: Simpaul is 100% a Binance Company. The M&A was fully approved by the Brazilian Central Bank in December 2024. This strategic acquisition strengthens our presence in the Brazilian market and enhances our capabilities in the fintech sector.

Role We are seeking an experienced Senior Finance & Accounting Specialist.

This role is critical in ensuring the accuracy, compliance, and efficiency of our financial operations in Brazil, in alignment with both local regulatory requirements and Binance’s global standards. You will be the main point of contact for accounting, tax, and regulatory matters, supporting the business in a fast-paced and high-growth environment.

Note: This role is 100% Remote, Work From Home based. Working Visa is not sponsored.

Responsibilities

  • Oversee the month-end and year-end closing processes in accordance with local Brazilian regulations — particularly Receita Federal and Banco Central do Brasil — while ensuring compliance with Binance’s global finance policies.
  • Collaborate closely with the internal finance team to manage accounting and financial processes, ensuring accurate and timely accounting and tax closing.
  • Act as the primary liaison with the external accounting firm, monitoring deliverables, service quality, and outcomes.
  • Serve as the subject matter expert for Finance/Accounting in implementing upcoming cryptoasset regulations in Brazil, advising on impacts, requirements, and execution plans.
  • Monitor, analyze, and ensure accurate and timely submission of all regulatory reports to authorities such as the Banco Central do Brasil and Receita Federal do Brasil (e.g., CADOCs, statutory financial and tax filings).
  • Develop and maintain the company’s accounting, operational, and capital policies in line with current regulations, business needs, and Binance’s strategic directives (e.g., capital adequacy policies vs. transaction accounting).
  • Track and interpret changes in laws, resolutions, and regulatory instructions related to brokerage and payment activities, ensuring ongoing compliance and regulatory security.
  • Oversee and support all tax-related initiatives, including compliance with tax obligations, implementation of tax reform changes, and corporate reorganization or optimization projects.
  • Lead external audit activities, ensuring alignment with both regulatory requirements and Binance’s internal policies and practices.
  • Drive and support system implementation projects and the launch of new products, focusing on financial and accounting requirements.
  • Collaborate with other teams across the company on business process development, monitoring, and continuous improvement (e.g., internal audit, internal controls, policy updates).
  • Support Binance’s regional Finance and Treasury teams with inquiries, process adjustments, and compliance initiatives to align reporting and operations with corporate policies (e.g., consolidated results reporting).

Requirements

  • 7+ years of relevant experience in Controllership, Accounting Management, or Finance for banking, payment, or other regulated financial institutions.
  • Strong knowledge in accounting, finance, financial operations, cash management, tax, and payment processes.
  • Proven experience in financial products, financial back-office operations, and banking relationship management.
  • Previous exposure to core banking systems (preferred).

Why Binance

  • Shape the future with the world’s leading blockchain ecosystem
  • Collaborate with world-class talent in a user-centric global organization with a flat structure
  • Tackle unique, fast-paced projects with autonomy in an innovative environment
  • Thrive in a results-driven workplace with opportunities for career growth and continuous learning
  • Competitive salary and company benefits
  • Work-from-home arrangement (the arrangement may vary depending on the work nature of the business team)

Binance is committed to being an equal opportunity employer. We believe that having a diverse workforce is fundamental to our success.

By submitting a job application, you confirm that you have read and agree to our Candidate Privacy Notice .

title: CRA II - Sponsor dedicated - Brazil Home Based
description:
Overview

CRA II - Sponsor dedicated - Brazil Home Based

Syneos Health® is a leading fully integrated biopharmaceutical solutions organization built to accelerate customer success. We translate unique clinical, medical affairs and commercial insights into outcomes to address modern market realities. Our Clinical Development model brings the customer and the patient to the center of everything that we do. We are continuously looking for ways to simplify and streamline our work to not only make Syneos Health easier to work with, but to make us easier to work for. Whether you join us in a Functional Service Provider partnership or a Full-Service environment, you’ll collaborate with passionate problem solvers, innovating as a team to help our customers achieve their goals. We are agile and driven to accelerate the delivery of therapies, because we are passionate to change lives. Discover what our 29,000 employees, across 110 countries already know: WORK HERE MATTERS EVERYWHERE

Responsibilities

  • Performs site qualification, site initiation, interim monitoring, site management activities and close-out visits (performed on-site or remotely) ensuring regulatory, ICH-GCP and/or Good Pharmacoepidemiology Practice (GPP) and protocol compliance. Uses judgment and experience to evaluate overall performance of site and site staff and to provide recommendations regarding site-specific actions; immediately communicates/escalates serious issues to the project team and develops action plans. Maintains a working knowledge of ICH/GCP Guidelines or other applicable guidance, relevant regulations, and company SOPs/processes.
  • Verifies the process of obtaining informed consent has been adequately performed and documented for each subject/patient, as required/appropriate. Demonstrates diligence in protecting the confidentiality of each subject/patient. Assesses factors that might affect subject/patient’s safety and clinical data integrity at an investigator/physician site such as protocol deviation/violations and pharmacovigilance issues.
  • Per the Clinical Monitoring/Site Management Plan (CMP/SMP): Assesses site processes. Conducts Source Document Review of appropriate site source documents and medical records. Verifies required clinical data entered in the case report form (CRF) is accurate and complete. Applies query resolution techniques remotely and on site, and provides guidance to site staff as necessary, driving query resolution to closure within agreed timelines. Utilizes available hardware and software to support the effective conduct of the clinical study data review and capture. Verifies site compliance with electronic data capture requirements.
  • May perform investigational product (IP) inventory, reconciliation and reviews storage and security. Verifies the IP has been dispensed and administered to subjects/patients according to the protocol. Verifies issues or risks associated with blinded or randomized information related to IP. Applies knowledge of GCP/local regulations and organizational procedures to ensure IP is appropriately (re)labelled, imported and released/returned.
  • Routinely reviews the Investigator Site File (ISF) for accuracy, timeliness and completeness. Reconciles contents of the ISF with the Trial Master File (TMF). Ensures the investigator/physician site is aware of the requirement of archiving essential documents in accordance with local guidelines and regulations.
  • Documents activities via confirmation letters, follow-up letters, trip reports, communication logs, and other required project documents as per SOPs and Clinical Monitoring Plan/Site Management Plan. Supports subject/patient recruitment, retention and awareness strategies. Enters data into tracking systems as required to track all observations, ongoing status and assigned action items to resolution.
  • For assigned activities, understands project scope, budgets, and timelines; manages site-level activities / communication to ensure project objectives, deliverables and timelines are met. Must be able to quickly adapt to changing priorities to achieve goals / targets.
  • May act as primary liaison with study site personnel, or in collaboration with Central Monitoring Associate. Ensures all assigned sites and project-specific site team members are trained and compliant with applicable requirements
  • Prepares for and attends Investigator Meetings and/or sponsor face to face meetings. Participates in global clinical monitoring/project staff meetings (inclusive of Sponsor representation, as applicable) and attends clinical training sessions according to the project specific requirements.
  • Provides guidance at the site and project level towards audit readiness standards and supports preparation for audit and required follow-up actions.

A successful candidate will have demonstrated previous success in similar roles in rapidly growing, security-first environments.   • You are able to integrate SSO into Okta, create workflows in Okta. You know how to work with APIs, and integrate one system to another. You’ve provided remote support to people in multiple countries, across time zones, and you’re familiar with shipping and receiving hardware and customs.

You write very well, whether it’s in tickets, email or Slack. You write in a clear, friendly, and concise manner, and are sensitive to different cultures. A desire to provide a magical experience for others — when they win, you win. You take security seriously, and you know what PGP is. You understand networking fundamentals and basic troubleshooting — TCP/IP, DNS, DHCP, VLANs, routing and switching. You must be able to competently and demonstrably know the troubleshooting steps and layers of the OSI model — you know how to methodically troubleshoot problems without wasting someone’s time. You can self-manage, and can accurately scope your project, priorities, and work across multiple teams.

Nice to Have

  • Some familiarity with AWS and experience with GAM and command-line interfaces.
  • Jamf certifications, Okta certifications, Google Workspace certifications.
  • Culture Fit: We look for a leader who thrives in startup/tech environments and embodies our values.

What We Provide

  • Comprehensive, best-in-class total rewards package that starts on your first day, including a competitive PTO package and ownership in the company. Through shared equity, Ledn employees are stakeholders in the company and the future of the digital economy. We offer remote work flexibility up to 180 days per year (subject to restrictions).

Working Environment

Overview

Ledn is a global financial services company built for digital assets, helping to improve the everyday lives of Bitcoin holders while building generational wealth for the future. We offer a suite of egalitarian lending, savings and trading products to digital asset holders in over 150 countries around the world. Our team is diverse and committed to democratizing access to the global economy through Ledn's products and services.

The core values guiding Ledn are: act with integrity always, own it, have a passion for progress, and lead with empathy. We are looking for motivated individuals to join us as we build, innovate, and revolutionize financial services.

The Opportunity

We are looking for an experienced engineer to join the Cybersecurity/IT Engineering team as a full-time Manager of IT. The ideal candidate is comfortable wearing many hats including supporting end users, managing endpoints, automating identity and access management, and administering cloud-based IT systems and tools. A successful candidate will have demonstrated prior success in similar roles in rapidly growing, security-first environments. The right person is passionate about automation, scripting, and building infrastructure as code.

You will be a participant in the design, implementation and management of our growing corporate cloud-first infrastructure and networks. You will combine innovation and creative problem solving with adaptability to the ever-changing enterprise infrastructure landscape. You will work closely with Cybersecurity/IT peers and key stakeholders across Customer Success, Marketing, Engineering and HR. The ideal candidate is an excellent communicator and fast learner who seeks a supportive environment to grow their IT skills and expertise. This role reports to the Director of IT.

What You Bring to Ledn

  • 7+ years in SaaS systems administration: Jamf Pro, Google Workspace, Okta, Slack, Jira, Netsuite.
  • Ability to create automations using bash, zsh, python, etc.
  • Experience with open source tools such as Nudge, CIS Benchmark scripts, SplashBuddy, Munki, etc.
  • Ability to integrate SSO into Okta and create workflows in Okta; knowledge of APIs and system integration.
  • Experience providing remote support across multiple countries/time zones; familiarity with shipping and receiving hardware and customs.
  • Excellent written and verbal communication skills; ability to explain complex concepts clearly and calmly.
  • Strong ability to craft clear tickets, emails, and Slack messages; maintain documentation and knowledge articles.

You write in a clear, friendly, and concise manner, are sensitive to different cultures, and are committed to providing a magical experience for others. You understand security concepts (PGP, OSI model) and networking fundamentals (TCP/IP, DNS, DHCP, VLANs, routing and switching). You can self-manage, scope projects, and work across multiple teams. You are comfortable with ambiguity and can make decisions with limited data.

  • Strong organizational and task-management skills.
  • Ability to work in a remote environment.

Nice to Haves

  • Some familiarity with AWS.
  • Experience using GAM and command-line interfaces to improve efficiency.
  • Jamf, Okta, Google Workspace certifications.

Culture Fit

We are looking for a leader who thrives in a startup or tech environment and embodies our values: adaptability, resilience, empathy, integrity, and accountability. A builder’s mindset, collaborative partner, and the ability to influence across functions are important.

What We Provide

  • Comprehensive, best-in-class total rewards package from day one.
  • Competitive PTO and ownership in the company through equity.
  • Remote-work opportunity up to 180 days per year (subject to restrictions).
  • A purpose-driven career and an inclusive, diverse workplace.

Equal Opportunity Employer

Ledn is an equal opportunity employer. For accommodation requests during the recruitment process, you may contact the Ledn team by email. Requests will be handled confidentially.

Ledn is a global, remote-first company with team members across North America, Latin America, South Africa and Europe. Due to high application volume, only qualified applicants will be contacted. Shortlisted candidates may be asked to submit a short video response and reviews of publicly available social media relevant to the role. No agencies or recruiters, please. We are looking for an experienced engineer to join the Cybersecurity/IT Engineering team as a full-time Manager of IT. A successful candidate will have demonstrated previous success in similar roles in rapidly growing, security-first environments. The right person is passionate about automation, scripting, and infrastructure as code, and is excited to help end users who need assistance.

You will participate in the design, implementation and management of our growing corporate cloud-first infrastructure and networks. You will be adaptable to the ever-changing landscape of the corporate infrastructure environment and work closely with Cybersecurity/IT peers and stakeholder teams (Customer Success, Marketing, Engineering and HR). The ideal candidate is an excellent communicator and fast learner seeking a supportive environment to grow IT skills and expertise. This role reports to the Director of IT.

You will be customer-facing and the first line of support; you own support and are passionate about providing an outstanding experience to employees via Slack, Jira, etc. We are primarily Mac environments. You will design, test, build, and document programs, policies and tools, and contribute improvements to existing knowledge. Self-management with the ability to scope work and coordinate across teams. Strong organizational and task-management skills; comfort with ambiguity.

Nice to Have: Some familiarity with AWS; experience with GAM and command-line interfaces; certifications (Jamf, Okta, Google Workspace). Culture fit: leadership mindset, adaptability, empathy, and a collaborative approach in a remote, fast-paced environment.

  • Start part-time freelance; earn your way into a full-time seat within 12 months based on results.

What we all have in common is an unshakeable conviction that digital assets can democratize access to the global economy and Ledn's suite of products & services can play a critical role in doing so. The core values that guide us are: act with integrity always, own it, have a passion for progress, and lead with empathy. Combining these values with our conviction make Ledn an unstoppable force in changing the world for the better. Come join us as we build, innovate and revolutionize financial services!

The Opportunity

We are looking for an experienced engineer to join the Cybersecurity/IT Engineering team as a full time Manager of IT. The ideal candidate is comfortable wearing many different hats including supporting end users, managing endpoints, automating identity and access management, and administering cloud-based IT systems and tools. A successful candidate will have demonstrated previous success in similar role(s) in rapidly growing, security-first, environments. The right person is passionate about automation, scripting, and building infrastructure as code. But, just as passionate about helping end users who are in need of help. You will be a participant in the design, implementation and management of our growing corporate cloud first infrastructure and networks. You will have a passion for innovation and creative problem solving, as well as be adaptable to the ever-changing landscape of the corporate infrastructure environment. You will need to be a highly motivated, dependable and an experienced technologist who shares our passion and wants to be a part of a fast moving and highly execution-oriented team. You will work closely with your Cybersecurity/IT peers and key stakeholder teams, including, but not limited to, Customer Success, Marketing, Engineering and HR. The ideal candidate is an excellent communicator and fast learner who is looking for a supportive environment to continue to grow their IT skills and expertise. This role will report to the Director of IT.

What You Will Do

You will be customer-facing, and the first line of support; you own support, and you are passionate about providing an outstanding support experience to our employees — via Slack, Jira, etc. We're all Mac.

  • You are a pro at troubleshooting, using the terminal, and making macOS work in the enterprise.

  • You will own the experience of tech onboarding of all new employees as well as tech retrieval of all outgoing employees.

  • You'll detail your solutions, craft help articles and automate busywork.

  • You're comfortable juggling help desk tickets and can effectively prioritise them.
  • You\'ll work on projects over sprints, and detail your work in tools like Jira (you\'re experienced with agile methods and sprints).
  • You\'ll set and work to your own objective and key results with minimal direction, and can align them to the team and the company goals.

What You Bring to Ledn

  • 7+ years in SaaS systems administration: Jamf Pro, Google Workspace, Okta, Slack, Jira, Netsuite.
  • Ability to create automations using bash, zsh, python, etc.
  • Ability to utilize open source tools such as Nudge, CIS Benchmark scripts, SplashBuddy, Munki, etc.
  • You are able to integrate SSO into Okta, create workflows in Okta.
  • You know how to work with APIs, and integrate one system to another.
  • You've provided remote support to people in multiple countries, across time zones, and you're familiar with shipping and receiving hardware and customs.
  • Unusually great communication skills across all media — you can make your ideas clear, and you can help people who might be frustrated or time poor without losing your cool.
  • You write very well, whether it's in tickets, email or Slack.

Qualifications (continued)

You write in a clear, friendly, and concise manner, and are sensitive to different cultures. A desire to provide a magical experience for others — when they win, you win. You take security seriously, and you know what PGP is. You understand networking fundamentals and basic troubleshooting — TCP/IP, DNS, DHCP, VLANs, routing and switching. You must be able to competently and demonstrably know the troubleshooting steps and layers of the OSI model — you know how to methodically troubleshoot problems without wasting someone's time. You can self-manage, and can accurately scope your project, priorities, and work across multiple teams.

  • Strong organisational and task-management skills are critical.
  • You're comfortable dealing with ambiguity, and sometimes making the right decision without all the data.
  • Nice to Haves: Some familiarity with AWS; GAM and command-line interfaces; Jamf certifications, Okta certifications, Google Workspace certifications.
  • Culture Fit: We're looking for more than just operational excellence — we want a leader who thrives in the startup or tech environment and embodies our values.

The Ideal Candidate

  • Has a passion for progress by being adaptable and resilient, and is comfortable navigating ambiguity in a high-growth, fast-paced environment.
  • Has a builder's mindset, excited to create, iterate, and scale IT practices.
  • Is a collaborative partner, able to influence across functions and cultures with empathy and clarity.
  • Demonstrates integrity and accountability, especially in managing confidential information across diverse legal and cultural contexts.
  • Has worked in a remote environment before.

What We Provide

As one of the world\'s leading digital asset companies, we provide tremendous growth opportunities. Comprehensive, best-in-class total rewards package that starts on your first day!

  • We offer a competitive PTO package that ensures you have the time off you deserve. Ownership in the company.

Qualifications

  • 7+ years in SaaS systems administration (e.g., Jamf Pro, Google Workspace, Okta, Slack, Jira, Netsuite).
  • Ability to create automations using bash, zsh, Python, and similar languages.
  • Experience with open source tools (e.g., Nudge, CIS Benchmark scripts, SplashBuddy, Munki).
  • Ability to integrate SSO into Okta and create workflows in Okta; experience with APIs to integrate systems.
  • Remote support experience across multiple countries/time zones; ability to handle shipping/receiving hardware and customs.
  • Excellent written and verbal communication; ability to explain complex concepts clearly and empathetically.
  • Strong documentation skills and ability to craft clear help articles; ability to manage projects and self-direct priorities.
  • Fundamental networking knowledge and troubleshooting (TCP/IP, DNS, DHCP, VLANs, routing, OSI model).
  • Self-management and ability to scope projects and coordinate across multiple teams.

Nice to haves: Some familiarity with AWS; experience with GAM/command-line tools; Jamf/Okta/Google Workspace certifications.

Culture & Benefits

  • Culture fit: leadership mindset, adaptability in a startup/tech environment, collaborative across functions, and empathy in cross-cultural contexts.
  • Comprehensive total rewards package starting on day one.
  • Competitive PTO; equity ownership in the company.
  • Remote-friendly: opportunity to work remotely anywhere in the world for up to 180 days (subject to restrictions).

You may reach out for accommodation requests at any stage of the recruitment process. Requests will be addressed confidentially. title: Product Manager, Lending
description:
Overview

Clutch is on a mission to transform Credit Unions into fintechs — helping them deliver digital experiences that rival the best banks and lenders in the world.

As a Product Manager on the Lending Application Intake team, you’ll support the core member application experience that powers our lending platform. You’ll work closely to deliver small features that improve the speed, accuracy, and usability of loan applications — from initial intake through decisioning.

This is a hands-on learning role where you’ll develop the fundamentals of product management within a fast-paced fintech environment. You’ll learn how digital lending works, how credit unions serve their members, and how to turn complex workflows into simple, delightful product experiences, driving impact to our credit union customers and their members.

About the Team

You’ll join a high-talent density Product & Engineering org with a culture of ownership, speed, and judgment. PMs here work shoulder-to-shoulder with engineers and GTM peers, driving clarity and tough tradeoffs instead of waiting for direction.

This is a pivotal time at Clutch: we are on a strong growth path, and how we scale account opening in the next 12 months will define how Clutch builds durable company leverage.

What You’ll Do

Within 3 months, you will:

  • Learn the fundamentals of Clutch’s Digital Lending experience, workflows, and customer personas.
  • Partner with a Senior PM and triad partners (Design + Engineering) to deliver small features and improvements end-to-end.
  • Collaborate with engineering to validate features and ensure quality delivery.
  • Shadow customer calls and internal standups to understand how fintech products serve real-world credit union needs.

Within 6 months, you will:

  • Contribute to backlog refinement, writing crisp product specs, and maintaining feature documentation.
  • Own a well-defined part of our product and lead quarterly planning for it with guidance from your manager.
  • Analyze user feedback and product data to inform backlog prioritization.
  • Present updates in demos and share learnings with your peers.

Within 9 months, you will:

  • Independently manage a small product area or recurring improvement track
  • Develop the ability to independently identify, scope, and propose enhancements that drive measurable customer impact.
  • Turning urgent needs into repeatable, scalable systems
  • Demonstrate growth in product judgment, cross-functional collaboration, and ownership mindset.

What You’ll Bring

  • Execution excellence : Proven ability to thrive in fast-paced environments; you bring urgency, energy, and follow-through. A strong signal is 2+ years of PM experience in B2B or fintech environments.
  • Collaboration skills : You partner across product, engineering, and GTM — holding the line on judgment while ensuring customers feel heard.
  • Growth mindset: A growth mindset and willingness to receive and act on feedback to improve quickly.

What’s In It For You?

  • Remote Flexibility : Enjoy the freedom of remote work from anywhere, balancing life and career seamlessly.
  • Unforgettable Off-Sites : Twice a year, bond with colleagues in exciting destinations, fostering teamwork and fresh ideas.
  • Paid Time Off and National Holidays : Enjoy 20 PTO days yearly and the National Holidays for relaxation and rejuvenation.
  • Stock Options : Joining us means having a stake in our success, so you'll receive stock options as part of your compensation package.
  • Home Office Setup : Create your ideal workspace with a dedicated budget for home office essentials.
  • Work Trip Budget : Grow personally and professionally with a budget for work-related trips and co-working.

About Us

Clutch is a revolutionary vertical SaaS company, proudly backed by Andreessen Horowitz (A16z), aimed at revolutionizing the way Credit Unions engage and change the lives of their members. As a champion of financial well-being, we address the urgent need for affordable lending solutions in an era where the average American grapples with over $155,000 in household debt. Unlike traditional financial institutions, Clutch develops software to turn Credit Unions into FinTech lenders and leverage their balance sheets to responsibly lend to over 130M Americans. Our mission extends beyond mere financial transactions; we strive to fundamentally enhance the way credit unions interact with their members. By integrating cutting-edge technologies and user-centric designs, we help credit unions provide seamless digital experiences that are on par with leading tech companies. This approach not only preserves but revitalizes the longstanding tradition of community and member-focused service inherent to credit unions.

Please note : This position is offered on a contractor basis. Applicants must have the necessary documentation and authorization to work in the country where the job is located. Clutch cannot provide sponsorship or assist with obtaining work permits for this role.

A Note About AI at Clutch : We love AI. We use it often and encourage our team to creatively and effectively leverage AI tools in their work. If you join Clutch, we hope you'll bring the same enthusiasm for exploring how AI can amplify impact, productivity, and innovation. That said, during the interview process, we want to hear your thoughts. Please approach interviews without the use of AI tools—our goal is to get to know how you think, solve problems, and communicate. Once you're in the seat, bring on the prompts!

description:
Overview

We are looking for an experienced engineer to join the Cybersecurity/IT Engineering team as a full time Manager of IT. The ideal candidate is comfortable wearing many different hats including supporting end users, managing endpoints, automating identity and access management, and administering cloud-based IT systems and tools. You will be a participant in the design, implementation and management of our growing corporate cloud first infrastructure and networks.

Ledn is a global financial services company built for digital assets, helping to improve the everyday lives of Bitcoin holders while building generational wealth for the future. We offer a suite of egalitarian lending, savings and trading products to digital asset holders in over 150 countries around the world. The core values are integrity, accountability, progress, and empathy. This role reports to the Director of IT.

Responsibilities

  • Provide customer-facing, first-line support to employees via Slack, Jira, and other systems; own the support experience.
  • Procuring and delivering technology equipment; manage tech onboarding for new employees and tech retrieval for leaving employees.
  • Design, test, build, and document programs, policies, and tools; contribute improvements to existing knowledge bases.
  • Support and manage SaaS applications (Google Workspace, Slack, Jamf Pro/Protect/Connect, Okta, Jira, etc.).
  • Manage Mac endpoint and mobile device management tools (MDM/EMM, Jamf, etc.).
  • Own and contribute to improvements on IDP and SSO (GSuite, Okta, etc.).
  • Detail solutions, craft help articles, and automate routine tasks.
  • Manage, respond to, and resolve critical incidents as needed; prioritize help desk tickets and work across sprints in Jira.
  • Set and pursue objectives and key results aligned with team and company goals.

What You Bring to Ledn

  • 7+ years in SaaS systems administration (Jamf Pro, Google Workspace, Okta, Slack, Jira, Netsuite).
  • Ability to create automations using Bash, Zsh, Python, etc.; familiarity with open source tools (Nudge, CIS Benchmark scripts, SplashBuddy, Munki, etc.).
  • Experience integrating SSO into Okta and building workflows; strong API integration skills.
  • Remote support experience across multiple countries/time zones; knowledge of hardware shipping/receiving and customs.
  • Excellent written and verbal communication; ability to explain complex concepts clearly and empathetically.
  • Strong networking fundamentals and OSI troubleshooting; basic TCP/IP, DNS, DHCP, VLANs, routing and switching.
  • Self-management with ability to scope projects and prioritize across multiple teams; comfortable in a fast-moving, high-growth environment.

Nice to Haves

  • Familiarity with AWS; experience with GAM and command-line interfaces for efficiency.
  • Jamf/Icva certifications, Okta certifications, Google Workspace certifications.
  • Culture fit: leadership mindset, adaptability, resilience, and ability to work in a remote, startup/tech environment.

Perks and Benefits

  • Comprehensive rewards package and paid time off; ownership in the company via equity.
  • Remote work flexibility up to 180 days globally (subject to restrictions).
  • Inclusive, diverse, and equal opportunity employment; accommodations available during recruitment.

The Opportunity

You will work closely with your Cybersecurity/IT peers and key stakeholder teams, including, but not limited to, Customer Success, Marketing, Engineering and HR. The ideal candidate is an excellent communicator and fast learner who is looking for a supportive environment to continue to grow their IT skills and expertise. About the Role

You will be customer-facing, and the first line of support; you own support, and you are passionate about providing an outstanding support experience to our employees — via Slack, Jira, etc. We're all Mac.

You are a pro at troubleshooting, using the terminal, and making macOS work in the enterprise. You will be responsible for procuring and delivering technology equipment. You will own the experience of tech onboarding of all new employees as well as tech retrieval of all outgoing employees. You'll design, test, build, and document programs and policies and tools, and contribute improvements to existing knowledge with your experience and background. You''ll support and manage SaaS applications — Google Workspace (GSuite), Slack, Jamf Pro, Jamf Protect, Jamf Connect, Okta, Jira, etc. You will work with and manage Mac endpoint and mobile device management tools — MDM, EMM, Jamf, etc. You''ll own and contribute to improvements on IDP and SSO tools (GSuite, Okta, etc.) You''ll detail your solutions, craft help articles and automate busywork. Manage, respond to, and fix critical incidents and issues as needed, through to completion. You''ll balance help desk tickets and prioritise them. You''ll work on projects over sprints, and detail your work in tools like Jira (you''re experienced with agile methods and sprints).

You''ll set and work to your own objective and key results with minimal direction, and can align them to the team and the company goals.

What You Bring to Ledn

  • 7+ years in SaaS systems administration: Jamf Pro, Google Workspace, Okta, Slack, Jira, Netsuite.
  • Ability to create automations using bash, zsh, python, etc.
  • Ability to utilize open source tools such as Nudge, CIS Benchmark scripts, SplashBuddy, Munki, etc.
  • You are able to integrate SSO into Okta, create workflows in Okta.
  • You know how to work with APIs, and integrate one system to another.
  • You''ve provided remote support to people in multiple countries, across time zones, and you''re familiar with shipping and receiving hardware and customs.
  • Unusually great communication skills across all media — you can make your ideas clear, and you can help people who might be frustrated or time poor without losing your cool. You write very well, whether it''s in tickets, email or Slack.
  • You write in a clear, friendly, and concise manner, and are sensitive to different cultures. A desire to provide a magical experience for others — when they win, you win. You take security seriously, and you know what PGP is. You understand networking fundamentals and basic troubleshooting — TCP/IP, DNS, DHCP, VLANs, routing and switching. You must be able to competently and demonstrably know the troubleshooting steps and layers of the OSI model — you know how to methodically troubleshoot problems without wasting someone''s time. You can self-manage, and can accurately scope your project, priorities, and work across multiple teams.
  • Strong organisational and task-management skills are critical. You''re comfortable dealing with ambiguity, and sometimes making the right decision without all the data.

Nice to Have

  • Some familiarity with AWS.
  • Used tools like GAM and command-line interfaces to do lots of work with less effort.
  • Jamf certifications, Okta certifications, Google Workspace certifications.

Culture Fit

We''re looking for more than just operational excellence — we want a leader who thrives in the startup or tech environment and embodies our values. The ideal candidate will have a builder''s mindset, be a collaborative partner, influence across functions and cultures with empathy and clarity, demonstrate integrity and accountability, and have remote work experience.

We Provide

  • Comprehensive, best-in-class total rewards package that starts on your first day, including a competitive PTO package and ownership in the company via equity.
  • The ability to work remotely anywhere in the world for up to 180 days (subject to restrictions).
  • A career with purpose and a company that removes barriers so you can love what you do.
  • Ledn is an equal opportunity employer and values diversity and inclusion.

You may reach out to the Ledn team by emailing for accommodation requests throughout all stages of the recruitment process. Requests will be addressed confidentially.

Ledn Working Environment

Our team is global, remote-first, and spans North America, Latin America, South Africa and Europe. Please note, due to high volume of applications, only qualified applicants will be contacted. Shortlisted candidates may be asked to submit a short video response and we may review publicly available social media activity relevant to the role. No agencies or recruiters, please. title: Information Technology Manager
description:
Overview

Managers of Information Technology, Ledn is interested in hearing from you! Ledn is a global financial services company built for digital assets, helping to improve the everyday lives of Bitcoin holders while building generational wealth for the future. We offer a suite of egalitarian lending, savings and trading products to digital asset holders in over 150 countries around the world. Through our products & services, we can make a difference in the lives and futures of our clients. Our team at Ledn is a passionate group of individuals from diverse backgrounds. The core values that guide us are: act with integrity always, own it, have a passion for progress, and lead with empathy. Come join us as we build, innovate and revolutionize financial services!

The Opportunity

We are looking for an experienced engineer to join the Cybersecurity/IT Engineering team as a full time Manager of IT. The ideal candidate is comfortable wearing many different hats including supporting end users, managing endpoints, automating identity and access management, and administering cloud-based IT systems and tools. A successful candidate will have demonstrated previous success in similar role(s) in rapidly growing, security-first environments. The right person is passionate about automation, scripting, and building infrastructure as code. You will be a participant in the design, implementation and management of our growing corporate cloud-first infrastructure and networks. You will have a passion for innovation and creative problem solving, as well as be adaptable to the ever-changing landscape of the corporate infrastructure environment. You will need to be a highly motivated, dependable and an experienced technologist who shares our passion and wants to be a part of a fast moving and highly execution-oriented team. You will work closely with your Cybersecurity/IT peers and key stakeholder teams, including, but not limited to, Customer Success, Marketing, Engineering and HR. The ideal candidate is an excellent communicator and fast learner who is looking for a supportive environment to continue to grow their IT skills and expertise. This role will report to the Director of IT.

Role Details

You will be customer-facing, and the first line of support; you own support, and you are passionate about providing an outstanding support experience to our employees — via Slack, Jira, etc. We’re all Mac. You are a pro at troubleshooting, using the terminal, and making macOS work in the enterprise. You will be responsible for procuring and delivering technology equipment. You will own the experience of tech onboarding of all new employees as well as tech retrieval of all outgoing employees. You’ll design, test, build, and document programs and policies and tools, and contribute improvements to existing knowledge with your experience and background. You’ll support and manage SaaS applications — Google Workspace (GSuite), Slack, Jamf Pro, Jamf Protect, Jamf Connect, Okta, Jira, etc. You will work with and manage Mac endpoint and mobile device management tools — MDM, EMM, Jamf, etc. You'll own and contribute to improvements on IDP and SSO tools (GSuite, Okta, etc.). You'll detail your solutions, craft help articles and automate busywork. Manage, respond to, and fix critical incidents and issues as needed, through to completion. You'll set and work to your own objectives and key results with minimal direction, and can align them to the team and the company goals.

What You Bring to Ledn

  • 7+ years in SaaS systems administration: Jamf Pro, Google Workspace, Okta, Slack, Jira, Netsuite.
  • Ability to create automations using bash, zsh, python, etc.
  • Ability to utilize open source tools such as Nudge, CIS Benchmark scripts, SplashBuddy, Munki, etc.
  • You are able to integrate SSO into Okta, create workflows in Okta.
  • You know how to work with APIs, and integrate one system to another.
  • You've provided remote support to people in multiple countries, across time zones, and you're familiar with shipping and receiving hardware and customs.
  • Unusually great communication skills across all media — you can make your ideas clear, and you can help people who might be frustrated or time poor without losing your cool. You write very well, whether it's in tickets, email or Slack.
  • You write in a clear, friendly, and concise manner, and are sensitive to different cultures. A desire to provide a magical experience for others — when they win, you win. You take security seriously, and you know what PGP is.
  • You understand networking fundamentals and basic troubleshooting — TCP/IP, DNS, DHCP, VLANs, routing and switching. You must be able to competently and demonstrably know the troubleshooting steps and layers of the OSI model — you know how to methodically troubleshoot problems without wasting someone's time.
  • You can self-manage, and can accurately scope your project, priorities, and work across multiple teams. Strong organisational and task-management skills are critical.
  • You're comfortable dealing with ambiguity, and sometimes making the right decision without all the data.

Nice to Haves

  • Some familiarity with AWS (not required to have certifications).
  • Experience with GAM and command-line interfaces to work efficiently.
  • Jamf certifications, Okta certifications, Google Workspace certifications.
  • Culture Fit: a leader who thrives in startup/tech environments and embodies our values.

The Ideal Candidate

  • Has a passion for progress, adaptability, resilience, and comfort navigating ambiguity in a high-growth, fast-paced environment.
  • Has a builder's mindset, is excited to create, iterate, and scale IT practices.
  • Is a collaborative partner, able to influence across functions and cultures with empathy and clarity.
  • Demonstrates integrity and accountability, especially in managing confidential information across diverse legal and cultural contexts.
  • Has worked in a remote environment before.

What We Provide

  • Comprehensive, best-in-class total rewards package starting from day one.
  • Competitive PTO and ownership in the company; through shared equity, Ledn employees are stakeholders in the future.
  • Opportunity to work remotely from anywhere in the world for up to 180 days (subject to restrictions).
  • A career with purpose and a culture that removes barriers so you can love what you do.
  • Ledn is an equal opportunity employer committed to inclusivity and diversity.

Additional Information

You may reach out to the Ledn team by emailing for accommodation requests throughout all stages of the recruitment process. Requests will be addressed confidentially. Our team is global and remote-first. Due to high volume of applications, only qualified applicants will be contacted. Shortlisted candidates may be asked to submit a short video response; we may review publicly available social media activity relevant to the role. No agencies or recruiters please. We do not accept unsolicited agency resumes and are not responsible for any fees related to unsolicited resumes.

Sobre nós

O Magalu é uma das maiores empresas de varejo do Brasil, reconhecida por sua inovação e presença digital. Com mais de 60 anos de história, conecta milhões de clientes por meio das lojas e de uma plataforma multicanal, oferecendo produtos e serviços de qualidade. A empresa investe continuamente em transformação digital, tecnologia e diversidade, criando um ambiente dinâmico e colaborativo.

Nós representamos uma macro-área de Data Analytics. Nosso time é dividido por pessoas com perfis variados de dados (Analistas de Dados, Engenheiros de Dados, Cientistas, Business Analytics, etc) e também por pessoas com perfil atuante em Pricing, Finanças, Produto e Planejamento Estratégico. Nossa função é navegar por todas as BU's da vertical (grand chef, plus delivery, aiqfome) e conseguir entregar recomendações de negócios baseadas no que os dados estão nos dizendo, para isso, você estará diariamente em contato com times de Marketing, Vendas, Produto, e Tecnologia.

  • Faremos estudos de eficiência, apontaremos caminhos e compartilharemos aprendizados;
  • Somos um time aficcionado pelo nosso usuário: seja ele o fominha, seller, CM, indústria ou fomer;
  • Criaremos uma plataforma de dados robusta, com automatização, dashboards e modelos de AI;
  • Se você precisa fazer a mesma coisa todo dia/semana, você precisa automatiza-la.

Descrição do Cargo

Como será o seu dia a dia

  • Liderança na Estratégia e Coleta de Dados: Liderar a identificação, avaliação e extração de dados de fontes complexas e variadas (bancos de dados, APIs, data lakes), definindo as melhores práticas e garantindo a integridade e relevância dos dados para as análises estratégicas.
  • Modelagem e Governança de Dados: Desenvolver e implementar processos robustos de limpeza, transformação e modelagem de dados, garantindo a qualidade, consistência e governança das informações em toda a empresa.
  • Análise Preditiva e Diagnóstica: Conduzir análises complexas, incluindo modelagem estatística, testes de hipóteses e análises preditivas, para diagnosticar tendências, identificar oportunidades de crescimento e prever cenários futuros.
  • Desenvolvimento e Liderança de Dashboards Estratégicos: Projetar, desenvolver e gerenciar dashboards e relatórios estratégicos para a alta gestão, focando em KPIs que direcionem o desempenho do negócio e facilitem a tomada de decisão em tempo real.
  • Parceria Estratégica com Áreas de Negócio: Atuar como um parceiro estratégico para as lideranças, compreendendo profundamente suas necessidades e traduzindo desafios de negócio em projetos de dados que gerem valor e impacto mensurável.
  • Otimização e Arquitetura de Consultas: Elaborar e otimizar consultas SQL complexas em grandes volumes de dados.
  • Contribuir para a arquitetura e performance dos bancos de dados analíticos.
  • Automação e Escalabilidade de Processos: Liderar a automação de pipelines de dados e processos analíticos, utilizando ferramentas de ETL/ELT para aumentar a eficiência, escalabilidade e confiabilidade das nossas operações de dados.
  • Comunicação e Influência: Comunicar insights e recomendações de forma clara e persuasiva para audiências diversas, incluindo executivos e stakeholders não técnicos, influenciando a tomada de decisões estratégicas.
  • Mentoria e Desenvolvimento da Equipe: Atuar como mentor para analistas de dados júnior e pleno, compartilhando conhecimento, promovendo as melhores práticas e contribuindo para o desenvolvimento técnico e analítico da equipe.
  • Inovação e Pesquisa: Pesquisar e implementar novas tecnologias, metodologias e abordagens em análise de dados e machine learning, mantendo a empresa na vanguarda das práticas do mercado.
  • Precisamos Que Você Tenha
  • Formação Acadêmica: Graduação completa em Ciência da Computação, Engenharia, Estatística, Sistemas de Informação ou áreas correlatas.
  • Pós-graduação ou mestrado em áreas relacionadas a dados será considerado um diferencial.

Overview

O que buscamos: um profissional com visão estratégica de segurança para colaborar com times de software, infraestrutura e operações, contribuindo com a melhoria contínua da postura de segurança da organização.

Responsabilidades

  • Definir e evoluir arquiteturas de segurança: projetar e garantir a implementação de arquiteturas de segurança robustas e escaláveis para aplicações e infraestrutura em ambientes Multi Cloud (AWS, GCP, Azure), alinhadas com as melhores práticas de mercado e requisitos regulatórios.
  • Apoiar no design seguro de sistemas: trabalhar com Arquitetos de Software e equipes de desenvolvimento para integrar segurança desde as etapas iniciais do ciclo de vida de desenvolvimento (Secure SDLC), realizando análises de ameaças (Threat Modeling) e revisões de design.
  • Garantir a segurança em ambientes Cloud e Contêineres: implementar e otimizar controles de segurança para plataformas Cloud (principalmente GCP, incluindo GKE, Cloud SQL), redes (VPCs, firewalls, micro-segmentação) e ambientes conteinerizados (Kubernetes), assegurando conformidade e proteção de dados.
  • Promover a cultura DevSecOps: colaborar para a integração de práticas de segurança nas esteiras de CI/CD (SAST, DAST, SCA, image scanning), automatizando verificações e garantindo deployments seguros por design.
  • Gerenciar Identidade e Acesso: projetar e implementar soluções de IAM, autenticação forte (MFA, SSO) e gestão de segredos para assegurar o princípio do menor privilégio.
  • Assegurar conformidade e auditoria: atuar para que as soluções estejam em conformidade com políticas internas e regulamentações externas (ex: LGPD, Bacen para clientes do setor financeiro), preparando ambientes para auditorias de segurança.
  • Documentar e disseminar conhecimento: criar e manter documentação técnica de segurança, padrões e guidelines, e atuar como referência para o time em decisões técnicas de segurança.
  • Visão estratégica e melhoria contínua: contribuir com a visão estratégica de segurança, identificar tendências e novas ameaças, propondo melhorias para a postura de segurança dos ambientes.

Qualificações / Requisitos

  • Experiência comprovada em Arquitetura de Segurança de aplicações e infraestrutura.
  • Conhecimento profundo em plataformas Cloud (AWS, GCP, Azure), com foco em serviços de segurança nativos (ex: Security Command Center, Security Hub, GuardDuty, WAF).
  • Domínio de Kubernetes Security (RBAC, Network Policies, image scanning, runtime security).
  • Experiência com DevSecOps e integração de segurança no pipeline de desenvolvimento.
  • Familiaridade com frameworks e padrões de segurança (NIST, ISO 27001, CIS Benchmarks, OWASP Top 10, Zero Trust).
  • Conhecimento em IAM, gestão de segredos, criptografia e proteção de dados.
  • Habilidade para Threat Modeling e análise de riscos.
  • Boa comunicação e proatividade para interagir com equipes multidisciplinares e stakeholders.

Diferenciais

  • Certificações de segurança (ex: CISSP, CCSP, CCSK, GCP Security Engineer, AWS Security Specialty, AZ-500).
  • Experiência em segmentação de rede, VPNs e SD-WAN para ambientes híbridos e multi-cloud.
  • Conhecimento em ferramentas de segurança como SIEM/SOAR, CSPM e Vulnerability Scanners.
  • Experiência com automação de segurança via scripting (Python, Shell).
  • Histórico de atuação em clientes do setor financeiro e familiaridade com Bacen e LGPD.

  • Perfil com liderança técnica, comunicação clara e influência multidisciplinar.

Na Avantti Tecnologia, você faz parte de uma cultura que respira #PaixãoPorTransformação. Aqui, valorizamos profissionais que unem visão técnica, colaboração e inovação para impulsionar resultados e construir o futuro.   • The ability to thrive in a fast-paced environment with ambitious goals and high standards

Nice to Have

  • Motion, animation, or interaction design skills
  • Strength in visual identity or brand expression
  • Familiarity with fintech or complex business systems

At Flex, we value passion, determination, and honesty. Even if you don\'t fully match the job specifics, we encourage you to apply. Unusual career paths and unique skills can help you stand out. We believe diversity drives our success.

Flex is growing quickly — you’ll help shape the direction of a product and company with real momentum.

We’re well-capitalized with strong backing and a clear long-term vision.

You’ll work with a sharp, driven team that values autonomy, clarity, and quality.

Join ambitious builders who care deeply about winning together — and having fun while doing it.

Overview

INTUS Windows is seeking a detail-oriented and systems-savvy NetSuite Accountant to manage the entry, accuracy, and validation of accounting data within our NetSuite ERP platform. This role supports Finance and Accounting operations by ensuring clean, consistent, and well-tested financial data across all core accounting modules — including Accounts Payable (AP), Accounts Receivable (AR), General Ledger (GL), and Payroll. The ideal candidate has a strong foundation in accounting, hands-on NetSuite experience, and enjoys a structured, process-driven environment. This position is responsible for data entry, testing, reconciliations, and configuration validation within NetSuite.

Location: Remote (EST work hours preferred). Remote work opportunity is offered as part of the role.

Responsibilities

  • NetSuite Accounting Data Management: Enter and validate accounting-related data in NetSuite; ensure completeness and accuracy of all entries across AR, AP, GL, and Payroll; conduct regular audits to identify and correct data inconsistencies or configuration issues; support daily transactional entry, adjustments, and posting of journal entries under supervision.
  • Testing & System Validation: Assist in testing accounting processes across NetSuite modules; validate system workflows for AP, AR, GL, Fixed Assets, and Payroll; perform UAT during NetSuite updates or enhancements; work with Accounting, Finance, and IT to identify and troubleshoot system errors or configuration gaps; help document testing procedures and results for audit and compliance purposes.
  • Month-End & Operational Support: Support the month-end close by preparing, verifying, and entering journal entries in NetSuite; assist in reconciling general ledger accounts and running reports; ensure system data is closed and locked appropriately in accordance with internal deadlines.
  • Documentation & Internal Support: Maintain accurate documentation of NetSuite processes, data input standards, and workflows; assist accounting team members in navigating NetSuite functionality and resolving data entry issues; contribute to continuous improvement of NetSuite accounting procedures and controls; perform other duties as assigned.

Qualifications

  • Bachelor’s degree in accounting, Finance, or a related field.
  • 2–5 years of accounting experience, with 2+ years of hands-on experience in NetSuite ERP.
  • Solid understanding of general accounting functions including journal entries, reconciliations, and month-end processes.
  • Experience working with accounting data across modules like AR, AP, GL, and Payroll.
  • Strong working knowledge of NetSuite ERP and accounting module navigation; understanding of US GAAP; excellent attention to detail; strong analytical and problem-solving abilities.
  • Ability to work independently and as part of a collaborative team; capable of managing multiple tasks in a fast-paced, deadline-driven environment; proficiency in Microsoft Excel and accounting data manipulation; effective communication and organizational skills.

What We Offer

  • Remote work opportunity.
  • Working hours 8-5 EST (preferred).
  • Monthly gross salary within the range of $1000-$2200.
  • Participation in our "One Window - One Tree" initiative.
  • Opportunity for professional development and growth.
  • A rapidly growing company with a collaborative and supportive team environment.

Overview

Computer Programming – Online Instructor - BYU-Pathway Worldwide role at The Church of Jesus Christ of Latter-day Saints

Get AI-powered advice on this job and more exclusive features.

Job Description

Candidates must be fluent in English and submit their application in English to be considered.

Only those currently living in and authorized to work in Brazil are eligible. The application system will store candidate information. Once submitted, application details will be shared with Church Education System (CES) partners involved in the selection process. Applicants may receive a rejection email during or after review; however, unless a direct rejection is received from the hiring manager, applications will remain active and under consideration.

Responsibilities

  • The Computer Programming Course Instructor is an important part of the instructional team. With a strong focus on the academic success of every student, instructors use their subject matter expertise, deep understanding of the curriculum, and student population to:
  • Identify trends impeding academic success.
  • Conduct targeted outreach and provide instruction to target groups and individuals.
  • Build capable learners, confident in their ability to succeed academically and in life.
  • Instructors do not develop lessons or assessments, nor do they issue grades on student work (grading is handled by a centrally managed pool of qualified Graders).
  • Their focus is on the academic success of every student in their care.

Important: This is a part-time work-from-home position with the following flexible schedule:

  • 10-12 hours per week (may vary week-to-week)
  • At least 5 days worked each week
  • Required attendance at periodic team meetings (as established by the department)

Course Description

Teaching and mentoring students (using Python and C#) for:

  • CSE 110 - Introduction to Programming
  • CSE 111 - Programming with Functions
  • CSE 210 - Programming with Classes
  • CSE 212 - Programming with Data Structures

These courses provide students with foundational computer programming skills, enabling them to contribute to software development teams.

Position Summary

BYU Pathway and BYU Idaho online courses are structured to include both an instructor and graders. Instructors are responsible for teaching and overall course delivery, while graders support the learning process by reviewing and evaluating assignments and providing students with constructive feedback. We are seeking instructors who will apply their skills and subject matter expertise to mentor students and facilitate teaching/learning experiences.

Qualifications

NOTE : An applicant’s résumé and official transcripts will be used to determine eligibility to serve as an instructor for the Computer Programming courses. Please clearly highlight relevant education, professional work, and technologies on your résumé.

General Instructor Requirements

  • Deep understanding of and commitment to BYU Pathway Worldwide’s mission, defining characteristics, and student population.
  • Fluency in English and Portuguese (required).
  • Adaptability to new processes, procedures, and technologies.
  • Excellent interpersonal skills: professional, respectful, and unbiased in sensitive situations.
  • Proven reliability and ability to meet deadlines with minimal supervision.
  • Proficiency in Microsoft Office, video conferencing, and discipline-specific software.
  • Experience with online teaching/learning, especially with at-risk learners (preferred).

Specific Course Requirements: Computer Programming

  • A master’s degree in computer science or a related field and two years of professional software development experience is preferred.
  • A bachelor’s degree and 3-5 years of work experience may be considered.
  • Experience with Python, C#, or Java is required.
  • Expert proficiency with basic programming concepts, such as variables, data types, collections, loops, functions, libraries, I/O, error handling, and testing.
  • Expert proficiency with basic object-oriented programming concepts, such as classes, methods, variables, and access modifiers.
  • Familiarity with data structures and algorithms.
  • Understanding object-oriented principles, such as abstraction, encapsulation, polymorphism, and inheritance.
  • Experience with version control software, such as GitHub.
  • Experience with code editors, such as Visual Studio Code.
  • Ability to communicate clearly in writing.

Additional Documentation Requirement

Candidates advancing to the next stage of the hiring process will be required to provide the following academic documents:

  • Official transcript (histórico escolar) of a completed bachelor’s or master’s degree. The transcript must be sent directly from the awarding institution, either in digital or physical format. Transcripts submitted by the candidate, regardless of format, will not be considered official for accreditation or academic credential verification purposes. This process may take time and may involve additional expenses, depending on the institution.
  • Copy of diploma (front and back) showing the date of degree completion or the date of the graduation/commencement ceremony (data da colação de grau).

Academic documents issued by Brazilian or international institutions are acceptable, provided they are officially recognized in Brazil and the country of origin (Bacharelado, Licenciatura, Mestrado, Mestrado Profissional). Not applicable: in-progress transcripts and associate-level degrees. A completed bachelor’s degree is the minimum requirement for this position.

Documentação Adicional Requerida

Os Candidatos Que Avançarem Para a Próxima Etapa Do Processo Seletivo Deverão Apresentar Os Seguintes Documentos Acadêmicos

  • Histórico escolar oficial de bacharelado ou mestrado concluído.
  • O histórico deve ser enviado diretamente pela instituição de ensino responsável pela titulação, em formato digital ou físico.
  • Históricos enviados pelo próprio candidato, independentemente do formato, não serão considerados oficiais para fins de credenciamento ou verificação de títulos acadêmicos.
  • Observe que este processo pode demandar tempo e gerar custos adicionais.
  • Cópia do diploma (frente e verso) que comprove a data de conclusão do curso ou a data da colação de grau.

Serão aceitos documentos acadêmicos emitidos por instituições brasileiras ou estrangeiras, desde que reconhecidos oficialmente no Brasil e no país de origem (Bacharelado, Licenciatura, Mestrado, Mestrado Profissional).

Não serão aceitos históricos de cursos em andamento e diplomas de nível tecnólogo. O requisito mínimo para esta vaga é um bacharelado concluído .

Quem somos

Na Qive, simplificamos o complexo para impulsionar o crescimento das empresas no Brasil. Sonhamos grande e agimos rápido, enfrentando desafios com entusiasmo e transformando problemas em oportunidades. Valorizamos o trabalho em equipe, a colaboração e o senso de urgência, sempre buscando a excelência em nossas entregas. Aqui, cada pessoa, seja cliente, líder ou colega, desempenha um papel essencial no nosso sucesso coletivo.

Na Qive, estamos comprometidos em mudar a forma como o mercado se relaciona com Documentos Fiscais Eletrônicos (DFes), reduzindo horas operacionais, conomizando custos e mitigando riscos. Nossa cultura é orientada pela inovação, responsabilidade e agilidade, sempre com o objetivo de liderar o mercado e oferecer soluções que impulsionem o crescimento de nossos clientes.

Venha fazer parte dessa revolução e seja o nosso elo para ajudar a construir um futuro mais simples e descomplicado para as empresas brasileiras!

Responsabilidades e objetivos da vaga

  • Gestão de Equipes de InfoSec: Liderar, motivar e desenvolver o time de segurança, garantindo excelência técnica e evolução de carreira;
  • Gestão de Riscos e Conformidade: Mapear riscos, acompanhar auditorias e manter os controles de segurança atualizados, mitigando vulnerabilidades em sistemas, processos e fornecedores;
  • Estratégia de Segurança: Definir e implementar a visão de InfoSec, alinhando práticas de segurança da informação aos objetivos de negócio e compliance (ISO 27001 e LGPD);
  • Resiliência Operacional: Estabelecer planos de resposta a incidentes, post mortems de falhas e priorização de soluções de longo prazo;
  • Arquitetura Segura: Apoiar times de engenharia e produto na definição de soluções resilientes e seguras, garantindo boas práticas em identidade, criptografia, monitoramento e resposta a incidentes;
  • Governança e Políticas: Estruturar e revisar normas, políticas e procedimentos de InfoSec, assegurando sua aplicação em toda a companhia;
  • Integração com o Negócio: Atuar junto a stakeholders internos e externos (clientes, parceiros e auditores) para demonstrar a maturidade do programa de segurança.

Requisitos

  • Experiência como Tech Manager, Security Lead ou correlata em empresas de tecnologia SaaS;
  • Conhecimento em ISO 27001, LGPD, gestão de riscos, auditorias e SoA;
  • Vivência com gestão de equipes técnicas, incluindo contratação, feedbacks, desenvolvimento e desligamentos;
  • Proficiência técnica em arquitetura de segurança de sistemas web e cloud (identidade, IAM, criptografia, monitoramento, incident response);
  • Experiência em traduzir requisitos regulatórios e de negócio em soluções técnicas viáveis;
  • Familiaridade com gestão de fornecedores de segurança e acompanhamento de contratos/SLAs.

Será um diferencial se você tiver

  • Certificações de mercado: CISSP, CISM, CISA, ISO 27001 LA/LI;
  • Experiência prática com DevSecOps e integração de segurança em pipelines de desenvolvimento;
  • Atuação prévia em empresas SaaS da área fiscal/financeira;
  • Experiência em FinOps aplicado à segurança, com otimização de custos de ferramentas e licenças;

E mais

Estamos em constante aprendizado para garantir que todas as pessoas possuam liberdade e respeito para falar e ouvir e sentir em seu dia a dia as experiências positivas apresentadas pela Qive!
